title: Understanding Correlation
text: Correlation measures the strength and direction of a linear relationship between two variables. If two variables are uncorrelated, their correlation coefficient is $$0$$.

title: Relationship Between Height and BMI
text: BMI is calculated using height and weight. If height and weight are uncorrelated, consider how BMI, which depends on both, might relate to height.

title: Effect of Height on BMI
text: Since BMI is inversely proportional to the square of height, an increase in height with constant weight leads to a decrease in BMI.
